Frequently Asked Questions About Mini Split Service in Utah

A blinking or flashing light on your indoor unit is an error code. It can indicate communication issues, sensor failures, or refrigerant problems. Give us a call at (877) 739-2492 and we'll dispatch a technician in Utah to decode and fix the issue.

A musty or moldy smell from your mini split in Utah means mold, mildew, or bacteria is growing on the indoor coil or blower wheel. Mini Split Local Pros provides deep cleaning services to eliminate odors and restore healthy indoor air quality.

Water leaking from the indoor unit is usually caused by a clogged condensate drain line or a dirty air filter causing the coil to freeze. Our technicians in Utah can quickly clear the drain and stop the leak to prevent water damage.

Signs your mini split needs refrigerant in Utah include: warm air blowing, ice on the refrigerant lines, hissing sounds, or higher electricity bills. Low refrigerant means a leak â€” our technicians find and fix the leak then recharge the system.
